<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead" summary="팀장 - 승인/결정/보고">
당신은 "eck-gateway-migration" 팀의 팀장(team-lead)입니다.

## 역할
- 팀원들의 작업 결과를 검토하고 승인/거절 결정
- 최종 마이그레이션 방향에 대한 의사결정
- Task #5 최종 리포트 작성

## 팀 구성
- devops-1: DevOps 엔지니어 1 - ECK+Istio 호환성 분석 + eck-elasticsearch HTTPRoute
- devops-2: DevOps 엔지니어 2 - eck-kibana HTTPRoute + values 업데이트
- k8s-expert: 쿠버네티스 전문가 - 기술 자문 + Helm 검증

## 프로젝트 배경
infra/eck-stack/ (Elasticsearch + Kibana)의 nginx Ingress를 Istio Gateway API HTTPRoute로 마이그레이션합니다.

핵심 컨텍스트:
1. ES Pod에 Istio sidecar injection 시 initContainer 충돌 이슈가 알려져 있지만, Istio Gateway는 sidecar와 독립적이므로 무관
2. ES는 호스트별로 다른 백엔드 서비스를 지정 (master/data/coord 노드)
3. Kibana는 TLS가 활성화되어 있음 (Gateway에서 TLS termination)
4. prod에서는 ingressClassName이 svc-search-internal (nginx 아님)

## 태스크 의존성
- Task #1: ECK+Istio 호환성 분석 (devops-1)
- Task #2: eck-elasticsearch HTTPRoute (devops-1) - #1 완료 후
- Task #3: eck-kibana HTTPRoute (devops-2) - #1 완료 후
- Task #4: values 업데이트 + 검증 (k8s-expert) - #2,#3 완료 후
- Task #5: 최종 리포트 (팀장) - #1,#4 완료 후

팀원들의 보고를 기다리며, 결과를 검토하고 승인해주세요.
</teammate-message>

http:

# - "ingest"

nodeSets:
- name: default
  count: 1
  config:
    # Comment out when setting the vm.max_map_count via initContainer, as these are mutually exclusive.
    # For production workloads, it is strongly recommended to increase the kernel setting vm.max_map_count to 262144

    # ref: https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/cloud-on-k8s/current/k8s-virtual-memory.html

    node.store.allow_mmap: false
  podTemplate:
    # The following spec is exactly the Kubernetes Core V1 PodTemplateSpec. Any fields within the PodTemplateSpec
    # are supported within the 'spec' field below.  Please see below documentation for the exhaustive list of fields.
    #
    # https://v1-24.docs.kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.24/#podtemplatespec-v1-core

      # https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/
      # affinity:
      #   nodeAffinity:

      #       nodeSelectorTerms:
      #       - matchExpressions:
      #         - key: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
      #           operator: In

      #           - antarctica-east1
      #           - antarctica-west1

      - name: elasticsearch

        # List of environment variables to set in the 'elasticsearch' container.
        # https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/inject-data-application/define-environment-variable-container/
        # env:
        # - name: "my-env-var"
        #   value: "my-value"

        # Compute Resources required by this container.
        resources:
          # Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required. If Requests is omitted for a container,
          # it defaults to Limits if that is explicitly specified, otherwise to an implementation-defined value.
          #
          # Defaults used by the ECK Operator, if not specified, are below
          limits:
            # cpu: 1
            memory: 2Gi
          requests:
            # cpu: 1
            memory: 2Gi

          # Example increasing both the requests and limits values:
          # limits:
          #   cpu: 4
          #   memory: 8Gi
          # requests:
          #   cpu: 1
          #   memory: 8Gi

        # SecurityContext defines the security options the container should be run with.

        # with the full knowledge of the effects of each field.
        #
        # securityContext:

          # Whether this container has a read-only root filesystem. Default is false.
          # readOnlyRootFilesystem: false

          # The GID to run the entrypoint of the container process. Uses runtime default if unset.
          # runAsGroup: 1000

          # Indicates that the container must run as a non-root user. If true, the Kubelet will validate the image at runtime to ensure

          # runAsNonRoot: true

          # The UID to run the entrypoint of the container process. Defaults to user specified in image metadata if unspecified.
          # runAsUser: 1000

    # ImagePullSecrets is an optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace to use for pulling any of the images used by this PodSpec.
    # https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images#specifying-imagepullsecrets-on-a-pod
    # imagePullSecrets:
    # - name: "image-pull-secret"

    # https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/

#
# Each Cloud Service Provider has different requirements for setting up Ingress. Some links to common documentation are:
# - AWS:   https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/alb-ingress.html

#
# nameOverride will override the name of the Chart with the name set here,

  # - Nginx: https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx/user-guide/tls/
  #
  # Kubernetes ingress TLS documentation:
  # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/#tls

  spec:
    monitoring:
      metrics:
        elasticsearchRefs:
          - name: dev-cmn
      logs:
        elasticsearchRefs:
          - name: dev-cmn
  nodeSets:
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # MASTER 노드 (3개)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    - name: master
      count: 3
      config:
        node.roles: [ "master" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data  # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 5Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: Always
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms8g -Xmx8g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 10Gi
                  cpu: 4
                requests:
                  memory: 10Gi
                  cpu: 4
          # Note. 형태소 분석기 사전 마운트
          # 형태소 분석기 플러그인이 설치된 경로에 사전 파일들을 마운트합니다.
          # NFS 또는 공유 PVC를 사용하여 모든 노드에서 동일한 사전 파일을 참조할 수 있도록 설정해야 합니다.
              volumeMounts:
                - name: dictionary-volume
                  mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: dictionary-volume
              persistentVolumeClaim:
                claimName: search-dictionary-shared-pvc
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
    - name: data
      count: 3
      config:
        node.roles: [ "data", "ingest" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data  # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 100Gi

        spec:

            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]

            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: Always
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms10g -Xmx10g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 12Gi
                  cpu: 4
                requests:
                  memory: 12Gi
                  cpu: 4
              volumeMounts:
                - name: dictionary-volume
                  mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: dictionary-volume
              persistentVolumeClaim:
                claimName: search-dictionary-shared-pvc
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
  ingress:
    enabled: true
    className: nginx
    pathType: Prefix
    hosts:
      - host: dev-cmn-elasticsearch.danuricorp.com
        path: /
        service: dev-cmn-es-master
        port: 9200
      - host: dev-cmn-keyword-analysis-api.danuricorp.com
        path: /
        service: dev-cmn-es-data
        port: 9200

    name: dev-cmn
    serviceName: dev-cmn-es-data # 형태소 분석기 떄문에 kibana가 데이터 노드에만 붙게 수정
  config:
    # Stack Monitoring UI 사용을 위한 설정
    # 기본값 true일 경우, 별도의 원격 모니터링 클러스터에서 데이터를 조회하려고 시도함
    # Self-monitoring(자기 자신을 모니터링)할 때는 false로 설정 필요
    monitoring.ui.ccs.enabled: false
  ingress:
    enabled: true
    className: nginx
    pathType: Prefix
    hosts:
      - host: dev-cmn-kibana.danuricorp.com

---
eck-elasticsearch:
  enabled: true
  # Note. `-es` postfix가 자동으로 붙습니다.
  fullnameOverride: "cmn"
  # Note. Stack Monitoring 활성화 - metricbeat/filebeat 사이드카 자동 주입
  # Self-monitoring: 자기 자신(cmn)에게 모니터링 데이터 저장
  # 만약 운영 환경에서 별도의 모니터링 클러스터를 운영한다면, elasticsearchRefs에 해당 클러스터 이름을 넣어주세요.
  spec:
    monitoring:
      metrics:
        elasticsearchRefs:
          - name: cmn
      logs:
        elasticsearchRefs:
          - name: cmn
  # Note. PodDisruptionBudget - Master quorum 보장 (마스터 노드에만 적용)
  podDisruptionBudget:
    spec:
      minAvailable: 2
      selector:
        matchLabels:
          elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/cluster-name: cmn-es
          elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/node-master: "true"
  nodeSets:
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # MASTER 노드 (3개)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    - name: master
      count: 3
      config:
        node.roles: [ "master" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data  # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 10Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          # Note. Master Anti-Affinity - 같은 노드에 배치 방지
          affinity:
            podAntiAffinity:
              requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                - labelSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/cluster-name: cmn-es
                      elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/node-master: "true"
                  topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          # Note. sysctl 설정을 위한 initContainer vm,max_map_count 조정 추가
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms10g -Xmx10g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 12Gi
                  cpu: 4
                requests:
                  memory: 12Gi
                  cpu: 4
          # Note. 형태소 분석기 사전 마운트
          # 형태소 분석기 플러그인이 설치된 경로에 사전 파일들을 마운트합니다.
          # NFS 또는 공유 PVC를 사용하여 모든 노드에서 동일한 사전 파일을 참조할 수 있도록 설정해야 합니다.
              volumeMounts:
                - name: dictionary-volume
                  mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: dictionary-volume
              persistentVolumeClaim:
                claimName: search-dictionary-shared-pvc
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # DATA 노드 (40개)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    - name: data
      count: 40
      config:
        node.roles: [ "data", "ingest" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 400Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms31g -Xmx31g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 48Gi
                  cpu: 16
                requests:
                  memory: 48Gi
                  cpu: 16
              volumeMounts:
                - name: dictionary-volume
                  mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: dictionary-volume
              persistentVolumeClaim:
                claimName: search-dictionary-shared-pvc
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # COORDINATOR 노드 (10개)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    - name: coord
      count: 10
      config:
        node.roles: [ ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 10Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms16g -Xmx16g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 20Gi
                  cpu: 8
                requests:
                  memory: 20Gi
                  cpu: 8
  ingress:
    enabled: true
    className: svc-search-internal
    pathType: Prefix
    hosts:
      - host: cmn-elasticsearch.danuricorp.com
        path: /
        service: cmn-es-coord
        port: 9200
      - host: cmn-keyword-analysis-api.danuricorp.com
        path: /
        service: cmn-es-data
        port: 9200

eck-kibana:
  enabled: true
  # Note. `-kb` postfix가 자동으로 붙습니다.
  fullnameOverride: "cmn"
  elasticsearchRef:
    name: "cmn"
    serviceName: cmn-es-data # 형태소 분석기 떄문에 kibana가 데이터 노드에만 붙게 수정
  config:
    # Stack Monitoring UI 사용을 위한 설정
    # 기본값 true일 경우, 별도의 원격 모니터링 클러스터에서 데이터를 조회하려고 시도함
    # Self-monitoring(자기 자신을 모니터링)할 때는 false로 설정 필요
    monitoring.ui.ccs.enabled: false
  ingress:
    enabled: true
    className: svc-search-internal
    pathType: Prefix
    hosts:
      - host: cmn-kibana.danuricorp.com
        path: /
    tls:
      enabled: true
      secretName: tls

k8s-expert입니다. eck-elasticsearch HTTPRoute 템플릿을 검토했습니다.

현재 `infra/eck-stack/charts/eck-elasticsearch/templates/httproute.yaml`에서 호스트 기반 라우팅을 `:authority` 헤더 매치로 구현하고 있는데, Gateway API HTTPRoute에서는 이 방식이 올바르지 않습니다.

## 문제점
```yaml
- matches:
    - headers:
        - name: ":authority"
          value: {{ .hostname | quote }}
```

`:authority`는 HTTP/2 pseudo-header로, Gateway API의 `headers` match에서 직접 사용할 수 없습니다. Gateway API spec에서는 `:` prefix가 있는 pseudo-header는 `headers` field에서 매치 대상이 아닙니다.

## 권장 방법
ES의 경우 호스트별로 다른 백엔드를 지정해야 하므로, **호스트별 별도 HTTPRoute**를 생성하는 것이 가장 깔끔합니다:

```yaml
{{- range $i, $host := .Values.httpRoute.hosts }}
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: {{ $fullName }}-es-httproute-{{ $i }}
spec:
  parentRefs:
    {{- toYaml $.Values.httpRoute.parentRefs | nindent 4 }}
  hostnames:
    - {{ $host.hostname | quote }}
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: {{ $host.path | default "/" }}
      backendRefs:
        - name: {{ $host.service | default (printf "%s-es-http" $fullName) }}
          port: {{ $host.port | default 9200 }}
          weight: 1
{{- end }}
```

이렇게 하면:
1. Gateway API 표준 `hostnames` 필드 사용
2. 호스트별 별도 HTTPRoute로 다른 백엔드 서비스 지정 가능
3. 기존 프로젝트의 HTTPRoute 패턴(`next-search/search-admin`)과 일관성 유지

수정을 반영해주시면 values 업데이트를 바로 진행하겠습니다.

# to the public internet, and as such is disabled by default.
#
# Each Cloud Service Provider has different requirements for setting up Ingress. Some links to common documentation are:
# - AWS:   https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/alb-ingress.html
# - GCP:   https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/ingress
# - Azure: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/app-routing
# - Nginx: https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx/
#
ingress:
  enabled: false

  # Annotations that will be applied to the Ingress resource. Note that some ingress controllers are controlled via annotations.
  # 
  # Nginx Annotations: https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx/user-guide/nginx-configuration/annotations/
  #
  # Common annotations:
  #   kubernetes.io/ingress.class: gce          # Configures the Ingress resource to use the GCE ingress controller and create an external Application Load Balancer.
  #   kubernetes.io/ingress.class: gce-internal # Configures the Ingress resource to use the GCE ingress controller and create an internal Application Load Balancer.
  #   kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx        # Configures the Ingress resource to use the NGINX ingress controller.
  #
  annotations: {}

  # Labels that will be applied to the Ingress resource.
  #
  labels: {}

  # Some ingress controllers require the use of a specific class name to route traffic to the correct controller, notably AKS and EKS, which
  # replaces the use of the 'kubernetes.io/ingress.class' annotation.
  #
  # className: webapprouting.kubernetes.azure.com | alb

  # Ingress paths are required to have a corresponding path type. Defaults to 'Prefix'.
  #
  # There are 3 supported path types:
  # - ImplementationSpecific
  # - Prefix
  # - Exact
  #
  # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/#path-types
  #
  pathType: Prefix

  # Hosts are a list of hosts included in the Ingress definition, with a corresponding path at which the default Elasticsearch service
  # will be exposed. Each host in the list should be a fully qualified DNS name that will resolve to the exposed Ingress object.
  #
  # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/#name-based-virtual-hosting
  #
  hosts:
    - host: chart-example.local
      path: /

  # TLS defines whether TLS will be enabled on the Ingress resource.
  #
  # *NOTE* Many Cloud Service Providers handle TLS in a custom manner, and as such, it is recommended to consult their documentation.
  # Notably GKE and Nginx Ingress Controllers seems to respect the Ingress TLS settings, AKS and EKS ignore it.
  #
  # - AKS:   https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/app-routing-dns-ssl
  # - GKE:   https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/ingress#options_for_providing_ssl_certificates
  # - EKS:   https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/containers/serve-distinct-domains-with-tls-powered-by-acm-on-amazon-eks/
  # - Nginx: https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx/user-guide/tls/
  #
  # Kubernetes ingress TLS documentation:
  # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/#tls
  #
  tls:
    enabled: false
    # Optional Kubernetes secret name that contains a base64 encoded PEM certificate and private key that corresponds to the above 'hosts' definitions.
    # If tls is enabled, but this field is not set, the self-signed certificate and key created by the ECK operator will be used.
    # secretName: chart-example-tls

# Settings for controlling Elasticsearch HTTPRoute (Gateway API).
# This creates per-host HTTPRoute resources, allowing different backend services per hostname.
# Each host entry generates a separate HTTPRoute resource for proper host-based routing.
#
httpRoute:
  enabled: false

  # Annotations that will be applied to all HTTPRoute resources.
  #
  annotations: {}

  # Labels that will be applied to all HTTPRoute resources.
  #
  labels: {}

  # Parent gateway references. Required when httpRoute is enabled.
  # ref: https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/api-types/httproute/#parentrefs
  #
  # parentRefs:
  #   - name: istio-gateway
  #     namespace: istio-system

  # Hosts define per-hostname routing rules. Each entry creates a separate HTTPRoute resource.
  # - name: unique identifier for the HTTPRoute resource (used in metadata.name suffix)
  # - hostname: the FQDN to match
  # - service: backend Kubernetes service name (defaults to '{fullname}-es-http')
  # - port: backend service port (defaults to 9200)
  #
  # hosts:
  #   - name: elasticsearch
  #     hostname: cmn-elasticsearch.danuricorp.com
  #     service: cmn-es-coord
  #     port: 9200
  #   - name: keyword-analysis
  #     hostname: cmn-keyword-analysis-api.danuricorp.com
  #     service: cmn-es-data
  #     port: 9200

  # Self-monitoring: 자기 자신(cmn)에게 모니터링 데이터 저장
  # 만약 운영 환경에서 별도의 모니터링 클러스터를 운영한다면, elasticsearchRefs에 해당 클러스터 이름을 넣어주세요.
  spec:
    monitoring:
      metrics:
        elasticsearchRefs:
          - name: cmn
      logs:
        elasticsearchRefs:
          - name: cmn
  # Note. PodDisruptionBudget - Master quorum 보장 (마스터 노드에만 적용)
  podDisruptionBudget:
    spec:
      minAvailable: 2
      selector:
        matchLabels:
          elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/cluster-name: cmn-es
          elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/node-master: "true"
  nodeSets:

    # MASTER 노드 (3개)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    - name: master
      count: 3
      config:
        node.roles: [ "master" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data  # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 10Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          # Note. Master Anti-Affinity - 같은 노드에 배치 방지
          affinity:
            podAntiAffinity:
              requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                - labelSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/cluster-name: cmn-es
                      elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/node-master: "true"
                  topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          # Note. sysctl 설정을 위한 initContainer vm,max_map_count 조정 추가
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms10g -Xmx10g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 12Gi
                  cpu: 4
                requests:
                  memory: 12Gi
                  cpu: 4
          # Note. 형태소 분석기 사전 마운트
          # 형태소 분석기 플러그인이 설치된 경로에 사전 파일들을 마운트합니다.
          # NFS 또는 공유 PVC를 사용하여 모든 노드에서 동일한 사전 파일을 참조할 수 있도록 설정해야 합니다.
              volumeMounts:
                - name: dictionary-volume
                  mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: dictionary-volume
              persistentVolumeClaim:
                claimName: search-dictionary-shared-pvc
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # DATA 노드 (40개)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    - name: data
      count: 40
      config:
        node.roles: [ "data", "ingest" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 400Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms31g -Xmx31g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 48Gi
                  cpu: 16
                requests:
                  memory: 48Gi
                  cpu: 16
              volumeMounts:
                - name: dictionary-volume
                  mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: dictionary-volume
              persistentVolumeClaim:
                claimName: search-dictionary-shared-pvc
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # COORDINATOR 노드 (10개)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    - name: coord
      count: 10
      config:
        node.roles: [ ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 10Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms16g -Xmx16g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 20Gi
                  cpu: 8
                requests:
                  memory: 20Gi
                  cpu: 8
  ingress:
    enabled: true
    className: svc-search-internal
    pathType: Prefix
    hosts:
      - host: cmn-elasticsearch.danuricorp.com
        path: /
        service: cmn-es-coord
        port: 9200
      - host: cmn-keyword-analysis-api.danuricorp.com
        path: /
        service: cmn-es-data
        port: 9200
  httpRoute:
    enabled: true
    parentRefs:
      - name: cmn-search-gateway
        namespace: istio-system
    hosts:
      - name: elasticsearch
        hostname: cmn-elasticsearch.danuricorp.com
        service: cmn-es-coord
        port: 9200
      - name: keyword-analysis
        hostname: cmn-keyword-analysis-api.danuricorp.com
        service: cmn-es-data
        port: 9200

eck-kibana:
  enabled: true
  # Note. `-kb` postfix가 자동으로 붙습니다.
  fullnameOverride: "cmn"
  elasticsearchRef:
    name: "cmn"
    serviceName: cmn-es-data # 형태소 분석기 떄문에 kibana가 데이터 노드에만 붙게 수정
  config:
    # Stack Monitoring UI 사용을 위한 설정
    # 기본값 true일 경우, 별도의 원격 모니터링 클러스터에서 데이터를 조회하려고 시도함
    # Self-monitoring(자기 자신을 모니터링)할 때는 false로 설정 필요
    monitoring.ui.ccs.enabled: false
  ingress:
    enabled: true
    className: svc-search-internal
    pathType: Prefix
    hosts:
      - host: cmn-kibana.danuricorp.com
        path: /
    tls:
      enabled: true
      secretName: tls
  httpRoute:
    enabled: true
    parentRefs:
      - name: cmn-search-gateway
        namespace: istio-system
    hostnames:
      - cmn-kibana.danuricorp.com
    rules:
      - matches:
          - path:
              type: PathPrefix
              value: /
